The Import Pipeline

What happens after a download completes.

Automatic import

When a download client reports a completed item, NGMS picks up the file path and runs it through the import pipeline automatically:

  1. Parse — the filename is parsed to extract title, year, episode numbers, quality, and language
  2. Match — the parsed title is matched against monitored series and movies in the database
  3. Quality check — the detected quality is compared against the item's quality profile
  4. Rename — the file is renamed according to your naming template
  5. Move — file is moved (or hard-linked) to the correct root folder path
  6. Notify — download complete notifications are dispatched
  7. Plex scan — if Plex integration is enabled, the affected library section is scanned

Manual import

Use the Import page to manually process files on disk that weren't downloaded via NGMS — ripped Blu-rays, pre-existing collections, or anything that fell outside the normal pipeline.

1

Import → Browse

Navigate to the directory containing the files. NGMS scans and groups files by their detected show or movie.

2

Review matches

Each file shows its detected quality and the episode or movie it matched. If the match is wrong, click the title to search manually and pick the correct match.

3

Import selected

Click Import to process. Files are renamed and moved. Any that fail (wrong quality, already imported, unmatchable) are left in place with an error message.

Hard links vs. copies

ModeWhen usedDisk usage
Hard link Source and destination are on the same filesystem Zero extra space — both paths point to the same inode
Copy Source and destination are on different filesystems Double space during seeding/retention period
✦
Recommended layout: Mount your downloads directory and your media root folders under the same bind mount or Docker volume. This ensures hard links are always available and you won't consume double disk space.

Naming templates

Rename patterns are configured in Settings → Media Management. Templates use token substitution:

Example series naming template 
# Folder
{Series Title} ({Year})

# Season folder
Season {season:00}

# Episode file
{Series Title} - S{season:00}E{episode:00} - {Episode Title} [{Quality Full}]

# Result:
# Breaking Bad (2008)/Season 01/Breaking Bad - S01E01 - Pilot [Bluray-1080p].mkv
